partnerQuote.title: Customer and quote authorization
partnerQuote.instructions: Find the customer by document. The system identifies their record and automatically verifies whether consent is current.
partnerQuote.documentInvalid: Enter 6 to 15 alphanumeric characters. The server verifies the document type and its owner.
partnerQuote.versionInvalid: Enter an integer version of at least 1.
partnerQuote.recoveryNote: This page address retains only the operation and organization. Reloading retrieves its result; if a retry is needed, enter exactly the same details. Documents and phone numbers are not stored in the browser.
partnerQuote.customerContinues: The customer can continue this request from their quotes in their own session. This operation does not accept offers or purchase insurance on their behalf.
partnerQuote.newWarning: A new operation is not a retry: it may create another quote. Retrieve the current operation's result first.
partnerQuote.shareConsent: Details for quoting through a partner
partnerQuote.shareInstructions: You may provide these identifiers to your chosen partner. Never share your password or session. The partner cannot authorize or revoke consent for you.

errors.consent: The customer's consent is expired, revoked, or not authorized. The customer must renew it in their own session.
errors.identity: These details do not match the registered customer. Check them with their owner.
errors.processing: The operation is still running. Retrieve its result or retry with the same identifier.
errors.retryable: The operation has no confirmed result. Send exactly the same details with the same identifier.
errors.conflict: This identifier is associated with different details or there is a conflict. Retrieve the result; do not change the details of a retry.
errors.invalid: Check the organization, product, customer and consent details. No quote has been confirmed.
errors.forbidden: Your session cannot access this organization, product or operation.
errors.notFound: The operation or requested record was not found. No quote has been confirmed.
errors.quota: The organization has reached its request limit or has another active operation. Wait and retry the same operation.
errors.response: The response does not match the requested operation. It is not shown as successful; retrieve its result.
errors.unavailable: The operation could not be confirmed. Retrieve its result or retry with the same identifier.

errors.invalidCredentials: The username or password is incorrect.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
errors.unavailable: Sign in is currently unavailable. Please try again.
errors.encryptionUnavailable: Open the site over HTTPS (or localhost for development) and use an up-to-date browser with Web Crypto to sign in.
errors.unexpected: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

partners.noProducts: No products are enabled for this organization.

errors.forbidden: Your account does not have the required scope for this section.

errors.quota: The request limit has been reached. Wait before trying again.

clientInformation.searchHint: Use the UUID only for legacy clients without a document.
clientInformation.documentHint: Enter the document without punctuation or spaces.
clientInformation.minimumDataNotice: Only the authorized risk indicator will be requested. If a source fails, partial information will not be shown.

errors.document: The number does not match the selected document type.
errors.consent: The client does not have current consent covering this query.
errors.client: The selected client is not registered.
errors.forbidden: The partner, product, or purpose is not authorized.

dashboard.error: The dashboard information could not be loaded.
dashboard.readOnly: Summary of persisted records. It does not change the active request or resume historical requests.
dashboard.emptyQuotes: You have no recorded quotes yet.

quoteRequest.title: Request a quote
quoteRequest.subtitle: Complete the details to generate a personalized proposal.

fields.destinationPlaceholder: Search for and select a country

quoteRequest.processingBody: We are validating the information and checking available plans. This may take a few seconds.

validation.destination: Select a country from the list.
validation.returnDate: The return date must be on or after departure.
validation.positiveAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
validation.creditReference: Enter a 4 to 30 character alphanumeric or hyphenated reference.
validation.flightNumber: Enter a valid alphanumeric flight number.
validation.futureDate: Select a valid date after today.
validation.weatherDates: The end date must be on or after the start date and the period cannot exceed 366 days, including both dates.
validation.insuredAmount: Enter a whole amount between 1 and 1,000,000,000 COP.
validation.summary: Complete all required fields correctly to continue.

errors.products: Available insurance products could not be loaded.
errors.destinations: Available destination countries could not be loaded.
errors.unavailable: The request could not be sent at this time. Please try again.
errors.productUnavailable: The selected insurance is no longer available.
errors.unexpected: An unexpected error occurred while sending the request.

profiling.cachedEvidence: The server reused cached evidence that is still current and linked to the current consent. Sources remain simulated.
profiling.sessionIdentity: Your identity and contact details come from your authenticated session. You do not need to enter them again.
profiling.title: Profiling information
profiling.simulated: Simulated data. This is not a real financial inquiry.
profiling.purpose: You may authorize Open Finance and Open Data for your quote until the displayed date (up to 30 days) and revoke here. Profiles last 15 minutes.
profiling.incompleteEvidence: Previous evidence is incomplete or does not include both permissions. It does not enable profiling. Review the terms and record a new decision.

decision.title: Your consent decision
decision.purpose: Purpose: calculate a risk profile for your insurance quote.
decision.permissions: The model requires Open Finance and Open Data permissions; otherwise no source is queried and no profile is generated. Review this request's scopes and sources.
decision.data: Only the data listed in this request will be used. All sources are simulated; no real providers are connected.

fields.validity: Future expiry with timezone (up to 30 days)

decision.rights: By authorizing, you accept the described use until the displayed date. You can reject it or revoke it later from this panel. Viewing this panel does not renew authorization.

revocation.title: Confirm revocation?
revocation.body: Your current authorization will be submitted for revocation. The profile will no longer be available. We will only show a recorded revocation after the service confirms it.

purposes.cotizacion: Calculate a risk profile for your insurance quote

profiling.beforeRequest: A profile will be obtained when you submit the request and will be linked to that quote.

errors.decisionExpired: The displayed date has expired. Reload and review the new date before deciding.
errors.incompleteRequest: The consent request is incomplete or contains invalid information. The decision will not be sent. Review the listed fields and reload.
errors.consent: A current authorization is required. Authorize profiling and create a new request if the previous one used another version.
errors.conflict: Authorization changed in another session. Reload before changing it.
errors.expired: The profile expired. Create a new request to obtain a current profile.
errors.unavailable: Profiling could not be loaded. No partial results will be shown. Retry the query.
errors.identity: Your identity could not be verified. Check your session before continuing.
errors.session: Your session is invalid. Sign in again.
errors.notFound: The request profile was not found. Create a new quote.
errors.invalid: The profile is incomplete, expired or does not match this request. Its data will not be shown.

quoteSummary.resumeError: This request could not be recovered. Retry from its card.

empty.title: You do not have any quotes yet

offers.acceptedMessage: This is the accepted offer for this quote.
offers.selectToContinue: Select an available offer to continue.

acceptance.consent: I confirm that I reviewed the details and accept the conditions and coverages of the selected offer.

errors.unavailable: The offer changed or expired. Return to the offers to select an available option.
errors.confirmation: The selection could not be confirmed. Please try again.

payment.title: Simulated payment
payment.disclaimer: This operation is a simulation: it does not charge money, request card details or issue a policy.
payment.backendRequired: Simulated payment requires a connection to the service.
payment.loading: Loading the simulated payment amount and status.

errors.session: Your session could not be validated. Sign in again to continue.
errors.notFound: This request could not be found for your session. Return to your quotes.
errors.conflict: This simulated payment attempt could not be reconciled. Refresh the status before continuing.

mortgageProfiling.title: Start profiling
mortgageProfiling.subtitle: Enter the customer and credit details to request their assessment.
mortgageProfiling.consentNotice: The customer must have made an explicit decision in the corresponding consent channel. This form only verifies and references that decision; it does not replace it.
mortgageProfiling.consentVerified: I verified that the customer gave explicit consent and that the reference is current.
mortgageProfiling.idempotencyNotice: Do not close this page while submitting. Retries keep the same operation identifier.
mortgageProfiling.recoveryNotice: To recover the result, enter the same details and retry this operation. The service will check that they match.
mortgageProfiling.newOperationWarning: Starting another profiling request abandons this retry; it does not cancel or delete the previous operation, which may have completed.
mortgageProfiling.resultBody: The service confirmed the profile and quote. This receipt does not contain an insurance offer.

validation.documentNumber: Enter a valid document containing 6 to 15 characters.
validation.birthDate: Enter a valid date of birth.
validation.phone: Enter a Colombian phone number with +57 and 10 digits.
validation.creditAmount: The amount must be at least COP 1,000,000.
validation.termMonths: The term must be between 12 and 360 months.
validation.consentId: Enter the UUID of the consent recorded by the customer.
validation.consentVerified: You must verify explicit consent before continuing.

errors.incomplete_data: The service rejected the request because required details are missing. Review the information.
errors.invalid_consent: Consent is invalid or no longer current. Verify the reference with the customer.
errors.unauthorized_partner: Your session is not authorized to start operations for this partner.
errors.idempotency_conflict: The details do not match this operation. Check them before retrying. Starting another operation does not cancel the previous one.
errors.service_unavailable: The profiling service is unavailable. You can retry without creating another operation.
errors.invalid_response: The service response does not match this operation or is incomplete. No result was confirmed.
errors.session_expired: Your session cannot start this profiling request. Sign in with an authorized advisor account.
errors.customer_not_found: The customer is not registered. Check their identifier.
errors.profiling_failed: The service could not complete profiling. Review the details and profile validity.
errors.operation_in_progress: This operation is still in progress. Retry with the same identifier.
errors.operation_retryable: The operation has no confirmed result. Retry with the same identifier.
errors.rate_limited: The partner has reached the request limit. Wait before retrying the same operation.
errors.advisor_context_unavailable: You cannot submit a profiling request: this web session does not have the authorized advisor and partner context.
errors.unexpected: Profiling could not be started. You can retry without creating another operation.
